english.note: Use this when focusing on someone's circumstances or position rather than the difficulty itself.

exampleSentences.english: Put yourself in his predicament and you will see how hard it is to make a decision.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你試吓諗下自己處於佢嗰種處境，真係好難做決定。
